item.title: Microsoft Teams: Teams Admin Center - Single pane for monitoring & troubleshooting for meetings and calls across the organisation
item.description: <p>Administrators can monitor meeting and call health across the organization, uncover recurring patterns, and proactively troubleshoot issues impacting users in both active and completed meetings and calls.</p> (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Temporarily pause all notifications
item.description: <p>Users can now temporarily pause all notifications to minimize interruptions and stay focused on important work, meetings, or other priorities, without changing their existing notification settings.</p> (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: OneNote: Suggested Artifact Creation in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: <p>Copilot Notebooks in OneNote now suggests artifacts to create, such as Word documents, Excel workbooks, and PowerPoint presentations, based on Microsoft 365 knowledge and the content in your notebook. Select the suggestion and Copilot will generate the artifact.</p> (GA: August CY2026) — OneNote, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Clearer text highlighting in dark mode and high contrast mode
item.description: <p>We've improved how highlighted text looks when composing messages in dark mode and high contrast mode, giving you a more consistent editing experience.</p> (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): New Rich Answer Cards
item.description: <p>Surface new model-driven, dynamically placed Answer Cards across top 7 segments: weather, sports, finance, images, video, places and news for Entra &amp; MSA users across all surfaces.</p> (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Excel: Extending support for Insights Services to GCC-H and DoD sovereign clouds
item.description: <p>GCC-H and DoD sovereign cloud customers will be able to use features in Excel run by Insights Services, including Analyze Data found on the Data tab.</p> (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft 365 app, Excel

item.title: Planner: Planner Agent chat in Basic Plans
item.description: <p>Introducing built-in Planner Agent chat with natural language Q&amp;A, smart task discovery, and in-plan task management.</p> (GA: September CY2026) — Planner, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.description: This release enables M365 Copilot to reason over Power BI enterprise data and returns grounded answers directly from Power BI reports and semantic models. item.description: Presenting PowerPoint slides in Teams just got better. PowerPoint Live now supports light mode, giving presenters the option to present in light, dark, classic, or high contrast mode based on their preferences and system settings. (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft Teams
